phases.name: Core Policy Lock
phases.goal: Freeze non-negotiable engine policies before expanding rules.

items.outcome: Default engine remains precedence-first, with scoring limited to bounded support roles.
Strong claims follow a structured source hierarchy instead of flattened consensus.
Conflicting traditions are represented as separate packs or modes, not averaged together.

phases.name: Default Core Refinement
phases.goal: Improve the date-only recommendation baseline without increasing source-risk.

items.outcome: Expand or tighten truc-to-activity mappings in the core synthesis engine.
Keep hoang dao/hac dao as a bounded modifier with explicit non-override behavior.

phases.name: Versioned Baseline Packs
phases.goal: Support explicit VN-practice or source-variant behavior without destabilizing default core.

items.outcome: Keep frozen baseline taboo families explicit and add future folk-taboo families only as packs or variant rulesets.

phases.name: Advanced Optional Packs
phases.goal: Add high-impact but high-variance rule families behind explicit versioning and validation gates.

items.outcome: Design nhi thap bat tu as an optional recommendation pack rather than default v1 logic.
Expand than_sat only after source tables and provenance policy are concrete.

phases.name: Profile-Aware Layers
phases.goal: Introduce user-specific recommendation layers without contaminating date-only outputs.

items.outcome: Implement personalization as a separate recommendation layer keyed by profile input.

phases.name: Safety-Sensitive Domains
phases.goal: Handle culturally sensitive activities only after explicit product policy and source constraints exist.

items.outcome: Keep burial or funeral output conservative by default and avoid aggressive automation.

phases.name: Confidence and UX Extensions
phases.goal: Add confidence presentation only when it reflects explicit rule semantics.

items.outcome: Expose confidence only if it can be derived from source mode and evidence convergence rather than invented percentages.

rejected.reason: Modern VN practice sources can inform UX and pack design, but should not become sole default logic authority.

execution_notes: Promote default_core items before optional packs.
Do not promote optional packs into default behavior without explicit ruleset or version boundaries.
Every promoted item needs deterministic tests and corpus coverage.
